arguments.value: HPIL EnergyTech and GINARES agreed to cooperate on expanding GINARES’s renewable energy projects, including its waste-to-fuel technology, for one year starting January 5, 2015. They agreed to work together, keep each other informed, and identify target cooperation projects and common goals within six months. The agreement says each party is an independent contractor, with no payment or compensation under the agreement, and each party pays its own expenses. The parties must keep confidential information private, comply with anti-corruption and export-control laws, and make reasonable further undertakings needed to carry out the agreement. Each side gives standard promises about authority, compliance, and no known litigation, and must indemnify the other for losses caused by breaches or false statements. Disputes are to be settled by ICC arbitration in Paris, in English, and the agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of Nevada, USA.
